title: Ya Ali Karbala me aag lagi
body:
YA ALI KARBALA ME AAG LAGI
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Ali Karbala me aag lagi,
Qanaye Mustafa me aag lagi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jal rahi hai Rasool ki masnad,
Qalbe Qairunnisa me aag lagi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar barehna hai dil jali Zainab,
Chadare Fatima me aag lagi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jal raha hai kisi ka pairahan,
Aur kisi ki rida me aag lagi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Roke kehti hai Saniye Zehra,
Utho Abid aba me aag lagi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala se jo shaam me pohunche,
Qalbe Zainulleba me aag lagi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekho aakar najaf se Ainullah,
Kaisi ye nainawa me aag lagi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad kar Fatima ka dar 'Hilmi',
Dekh ab Karbala me aag lagi...
